parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the same ESM, /output, manual argv parsing, black-box probing, no-python, and no-external-dependency requirements from the prompt, then sought a byte-identical behavioral spec.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The plan placed exhaustive probing and synthesis in one workflow with four probe dimensions and a later spec synthesis step. The parent implicitly deferred implementation ownership until the workflow finished.
parallel.implementation: The parent and children built scratch probes and temporary harnesses under /tmp, but no required /output/test10.mjs or library module implementation was created before timeout.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No integration or final delivery occurred. Artifact validation found an empty artifact directory and the final response file is empty.
parallel.verification: Parallel did extensive black-box probing of the reference executable, but because no port was delivered, there was no integrated verification of a final JS solution.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with result null after repeated stalls/retries; the agent timed out with return code 143 and the official evaluator scored 0/100.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM, /output, no external dependency, manual argv, black-box behavior, .mjs suffix, and hierarchical module requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor handled probing, spec inference, implementation, fixes, and verification without delegation or cross-agent handoff.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote /output/test10.mjs plus bech32, argparse, int parsing, formatting, text, traceback, and error modules using ESM imports and exports.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial delivered the expected entry file and module tree, then adjusted argparse help behavior after reading its own implementation.
serial.verification: Serial compared samples, help output, 200 random valid cases, 120 messy/invalid cases, and post-edit sample/help behavior against the executable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official status still marks solution_passed false, with 98/100 samples passing; the mounted evidence does not expose the two failing hidden cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel understood the prompt and probed many behavioral requirements but did not turn them into the required /output ESM files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used the same prompt, probed the executable, and translated the requirements into a delivered ESM module hierarchy.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized requirements were similar; serial satisfied the delivery requirement, while parallel stalled before creating any deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into four research probes followed by synthesis, with the parent waiting to implement after the workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in one actor and moved from probing directly into writing the implementation modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's ownership plan front-loaded research into a workflow gate, while serial preserved end-to-end implementation ownership.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed for probing dimensions, but the workflow result was null and no synthesized implementation spec reached the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained probe findings in one local context and used them directly while writing modules and fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The serial path avoided cross-agent result aggregation, while the parallel path depended on a workflow handoff that never completed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote only temporary differential harness files outside /output and did not create the required JS implementation artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote errors, text, pyint, format, argparse, traceback, bech32 modules, and the test10.mjs entry point under /output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial implemented the port; parallel performed analysis and scratch tooling without producing the deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent polling showed the workflow still running; the workflow state ended killed with only partial child results and no aggregate spec returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used its own probe results immediately and continued through edits, verification, and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel never crossed the workflow-result boundary into implementation; serial had no such join point.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel has no final shared implementation tree to integrate, and no concrete concurrent write collision appears in the mounted evidence.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced a coherent module tree with local ESM imports and a single entry file recognized by artifact validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material integration difference is absence versus presence of a complete artifact tree, not a merge conflict.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified reference behavior through probes, but could not verify a delivered JS port because no port was written.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed byte comparisons on samples, help text, broad edge cases, 200 random valid inputs, and 120 messy invalid inputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's verification was tied to the implemented output; parallel's verification remained pre-implementation research.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran to the 2399-second timeout while the workflow consumed most of the cell budget and was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 1151 seconds, leaving 1247 seconds of remaining budget according to provider retry metadata.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's closure was forced by budget exhaustion before delivery; serial reached normal completion and final reporting.

outcome_analysis.explanation: By the validator's official boolean this is both_fail because serial solution_passed is also false, but the official quality records are materially divergent: parallel delivered no artifact and scored 0/100, while serial delivered the expected files and scored 98/100. The directly evidenced process difference is that parallel blocked implementation behind an exhaustive probe/spec workflow that was killed before returning a final spec, while serial kept the work local, wrote the ESM implementation tree, and verified it before closure.
parallel_contributors: The parent launched a probe/spec workflow before implementation and waited on it instead of writing the deliverable.
The workflow was killed with result null after stalls/retries, leaving artifact validation with an empty file list.
serial_contributors: Serial converted probe findings into a complete /output module tree and test10.mjs entry file.
Serial ran sample, help, random valid, and random messy invalid differential checks before final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still missed two of 100 hidden official samples, so its boolean solution_passed remains false despite the high pass rate.
The mounted evidence does not show the hidden failing cases, so the two remaining serial misses are not attributed to a parallel coordination pattern.
evaluator_effects: Official pass/fail is all-or-nothing here: serial has pass_rate 0.98 but status.json:evaluation still records solution_passed false.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause

No separately produced implementation components reached a state where cross-component integration ownership was missing.

The parent retained end-to-end intent and waited on the workflow; the problem was sequencing behind the workflow gate, not an unowned pipeline transition.

The parent chose an exhaustive probe/spec workflow before implementation, and the workflow's phases were Probe then Synthesize with no implementation or delivery phase. The parent waited on that gate until timeout, leaving no artifact.
